descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. And it’s dyed with pure color all the way through so there’s no white core. * 24 sheets * 8-1/2" x 11" * Pacific Point * Acid free * Lignin free

images.description: A solid bright blue cardstock or paper product displayed flat against a light neutral background. The rectangular sheet appears to be a standard card-making supply with clean edges and uniform color throughout.

descriptions.text: Make a colorful impression with our signature ink. Classic Stampin' Ink Refills come in exclusive Stampin' Up! colors, grouped in collections to take the guesswork out of product coordination. * Fast drying, dye-based ink * Pacific Point * Acid free * Use to re-ink Classic Stampin’ Pads or use for spritzing or watercoloring * Coordinates with Stampin’ Up! cardstock, markers, and embellishments * 0.5 fl. oz. (14.8 ml)

images.description: A bottle of Stampin' Up Classic Stampin' Ink in Pacific Point, a water-based dye ink. The small dropper bottle has a white cap and contains dark blue-gray liquid, with a white label featuring blue branding and multilingual product information.
